Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on a tagged COSE_Sign1 structure (COSE_Sign1_Tagged, CBOR tag 18) with attached payload. The implementation shall add only the minimum mandatory components: the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain. The unprotected headers map shall not be present. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
